description: High-performance structured logging for .NET 9. Striped async channel queue, MessageTemplate caching, object pooling, PII masking, correlation ID auto-propagation, per-sink minimum levels, per-category log levels, HTTP context enrichers (RequestId, UserContext), one-line correlation middleware, and built-in ASP.NET Core health check. MEL ILogger<T> compatible — drop-in replacement for Serilog/NLog.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.8 — Correctness fixes (production-safe upgrade from 1.0.6/1.0.7)
• Fixed: shared Task[] buffer in LogPipeline caused data race when 2+ sinks configured — each ProcessAsync now uses ArrayPool<Task> per-invocation
• Fixed: sink exception now caught per-sink with SinkFailureCount counter — drainer stripe no longer permanently killed by a single bad sink write
• Fixed: PooledLogEvent.ReturnToPool() now in finally block — pool leak on sink exception eliminated
• Fixed: TotalDropped counter always returned 0 — BoundedChannel.TryWrite always returns true with DropOldest; drop detection now uses atomic per-stripe occupancy counter (race-free under 32 concurrent producers)
• Fixed: critical drainer stripe used wrong index (_stripeCount instead of -1 sentinel) — Error/Critical events were silently not processed during drain; 3 unit tests now cover this path
• Fixed: shutdown race between late producers and DrainAndStopAsync — replaced plain _disposed int with coordinated state machine (Accepting/Draining/Stopped)
• Fixed: category prefix filter matched "Microsoft" against "MicrosoftExtra" — now requires exact match or dot boundary
• Added: SinkSharpLogger.ClearCallerCaptures() for test teardown
• 230 tests, all passing
v1.0.7 — Bug fixes
• Event delivery guaranteed at all producer counts — DrainAndStopAsync() now waits for all drainer tasks to finish before returning; previously returned early leaving events unprocessed
• Lock contention eliminated from hot path — enricher list and HTTP context capture list are now lock-free on the read path; contentions reduced from 34+ to near-zero at 8+ threads
v1.0.6 — New features
• AddSinkSharpRequestId()   — stamps RequestId from HttpContext.TraceIdentifier on every HTTP request event
• AddSinkSharpUserContext() — stamps UserId, UserName, UserRole (authenticated requests only)
• AddSinkSharpRequestPath() — stamps HttpMethod + RequestPath on every HTTP request event
• AddSinkSharpElapsedTime() — stamps ElapsedMs since request start (requires app.UseSinkSharp())
• All four require builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor()
v1.0.5 — New features
• WriteTo(sink, minLevel) — per-sink minimum level; WithDashboard(out sink, minLevel)
• WithMachineName() — standalone MachineName enricher
• .Filter(predicate) — drop events before enqueue, zero allocation
• .WithEnricher(enricher, when: predicate) — conditional enrichment
• SetGlobalLevel() / GetGlobalLevel() — runtime level change without restart
• app.UseSinkSharp() — X-Correlation-Id middleware + ElapsedTime stopwatch
v1.0.4 — Bug fixes: DisposeAsync idempotent, phone PII regex corrected
v1.0.1 — Bug fix: email PII regex corrected
v1.0.0 — Initial release: async channel queue, MEL ILogger, PII masking, correlation ID
See full changelog: https://github.com/SinkSharp/CHANGELOG.md
